name: manual_419534
claim: When an unsafe endpoint override falls back to an environment-derived host, validate and reconstruct the fallback through the same endpoint-policy boundary; otherwise rejected metadata-service destinations can re-enter through the recovery path.

decisions.notes: PT PR #352 review found that resolve_local_or_remote validated the override but directly interpolated fallback_ip after rejection, allowing a cloud-metadata address to reach later HTTP consumers. A focused RED→GREEN regression now requires safe loopback fallback.
